<includeonly></includeonly><noinclude>{{#cargo_declare:_table=AbilityClasses
|AbilityKey=String
|Class=String
|RequiredLevel=Integer
}}
Declare-only owner of the <code>AbilityClasses</code> junction (one row per ability×class, with the per-class required level). <code>AbilityKey</code> is the ability StableKey; <code>Class</code> is the canonical class name. Rows are written by the ability templates ({{tl|Spell}}, {{tl|Skill}}), which <code>#cargo_attach</code> this table; this template stores nothing itself.
</noinclude>
